title: ophrys heldreichii var. pharia
intro: Ophrys heldreichii var. pharia, commonly known as the Balkan bee orchid, is a type of orchid native to the Balkan Peninsula. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its antimicrobial and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys heldreichii var. pharia include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
